name: How does the local Colorado climate affect bathroom flooring choices?

mainEntity.name: How does the local Colorado climate affect bathroom flooring choices?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area and surrounding communities, seasonal humidity shifts and cold winters require careful material selection and acclimation. Cold temperatures make tile surfaces chilly, leading many local homeowners to pair tile with radiant floor heating systems. Furthermore, local homes experience dry winter air alternating with humid bathroom use, meaning vinyl and wood subfloors expand and contract significantly. Allowing flooring boxes to acclimate in your home for at least 48 hours ensures materials do not buckle or separate once installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dry winters and temperature shifts cause subfloor movement, requiring proper material acclimation and making radiant underfloor heating a popular pairing with tile.
